# LinkedIn Company Details from URL

> Turn a LinkedIn company URL into website, industry, headcount, offices, specialties, and recent posts with the Mawsool Actor on Apify.

This repository is an example client. Run the published Mawsool Actor on Apify with your own Apify token. Contact info@mawsool.tech · osama@mawsool.tech. Product site: https://mawsool.tech.

## Actors

- [LinkedIn Company Details from URL](https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-details): the Actor this code runs
- [All Mawsool Actors](https://apify.com/oday): the full LinkedIn data suite

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-company-enrichment/blob/main/README.md): how to run the example and what it returns
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-company-enrichment/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents
- [Example CSV](https://github.com/odayali1/linkedin-company-enrichment/blob/main/examples/input.csv): input shape
